name: demo
description: Demo application for Web Programming course

scripts.import:db-docker: docker cp ./data/kulturne-dediscine.json sp-mongo-db:/kulturne-dediscine.json; docker exec -it sp-mongo-db mongoimport --db Demo --collection Locations --mode upsert --upsertFields id --jsonArray --file kulturne-dediscine.json; docker exec -it sp-mongo-db rm -rf kulturne-dediscine.json
scripts.transfer:db-docker-atlas: docker exec -it sp-mongo-db bash -c "mongodump -h localhost -d Demo -o ./"; docker exec -it sp-mongo-db bash -c "mongorestore --drop --uri mongodb+srv://app@demo.uhiawaf.mongodb.net ./Demo/Locations.bson"; docker exec -it sp-mongo-db bash -c "rm -rf ./Demo"

author: Dejan Lavbič <dejan@lavbic.net>
